messages:
omar (AE): Heads-up 15: EdgeCare RFP follow-up. They pushed back on "data residency" language and want confirmation on encryption at rest + HSM. Also asked for a short capability matrix mapping to their checklist and a POC that uses non-PII synthetic data only. Need owners.

lina (solutions): I'll assemble the capability matrix and call out feature parity for dedicated vs hosted. Question: Do we include quantized model perf numbers in the matrix or attach them as benchmark appendix?

nidhi (security): Include a one-liner in the matrix and attach the benchmark appendix separately. Security answers: we support BYOK via customer KMS, HSM wrap (PKCS#11), FIPS 140-2 level info in appendix. Also can provide an HSM key-wrapping runbook for private. I'll attach the filled security questionnaire.

ashwin (eng-sre): For POC network constraints we can do VPC peering or PrivateLink. If they require strict egress blocking we can deploy a private-only routing with no internet egress from pods. Need their preferred pattern. Also will prepare a runbook for provisioning.

omar (AE): They require: 1) committed throughput for POC (sustained 500 rps), 2) Model rollback within 5 minutes, 3) Audit trail for every API call. Can we map those to product capabilities?

lina (solutions): Mapping: 1) Throughput: Dedicated reserved pods + pinning -> yes. 2) Rollback: We support pinned model versions and immediate rollback policy (can rollback within seconds depending on KV warmup). 3) Audit trail: token-level logs + API request traces retained 90 days. I'll add short notes and link to docs.

julia (growth): EdgeCare wants a short summary they can hand to procurement. Can we produce a 1-page capability summary + price bands?

lina (solutions): I'll make a 1-pager and a two-scenario price band (hosted burst vs reserved monthly). Attaching draft pricing sheet.

lina (solutions): Attachment: https://redwood.s3/pricing/edgecare-bands-v1.xlsx

nidhi (security): Attachment: https://redwood.s3/security/edgecare-qna-filled.pdf

ashwin (eng-sre): Quick ops snippet for the provisioning doc (for their infra team):
```yaml
deployment_mode: dedicated
pods:
  - type: reserved
    gpu: a100x4
    count: 3
    throughput_pin_rps: 600
network:
  peering: vpc
  region: us-east-1
  egress_policy: private-only
```
This should meet the 500 rps sustained with headroom for spikes.

omar (AE): They explicitly asked for "data minimization" during the POC 12: want no logs containing patient identifiers. What guardrails can we promise?

nidhi (security): For POC we can enable minimal logging mode: redact PII at ingress (prompt scrubbing), disable request/response archiving, and keep only aggregated metrics. However, we require an NDA before we change logging defaults. Will note in the response.

legal-bot: Please do not share customer PII in public S3 links. Use private share for the exec NDA and signed docs. :lock:

omar (AE): Good catch. I'll confirm NDA status with the buyer and push them the private share link.

lina (solutions): Test plan for POC acceptance (short): 1) sustained throughput 500rps for 30 min; 2) 95th pct latency <= 150ms; 3) rollback sanity test; 4) sample QA correctness tests on synthetic prompts. Draft attached.

lina (solutions): Attachment: https://redwood.s3/pocs/edgecare-poc-plan-v1.md

ashwin (eng-sre): Ops blocker: they provided CIDR 172.31.0.0/16 which overlaps our staging pool. Need them to provide alternate non-overlapping /20. Also request their cloud account ID for peering.

omar (AE): I'll ask them to change to 172.29.0.0/20 and get account ID. Also asking if they prefer VPC peering vs PrivateLink.

nidhi (security): One more compliance note: if PII might be present inadvertently our DLP pipeline will flag and quarantine. For the POC ask them to attest to synthetic data and sign a data processing addendum.

julia (growth): I'll prep the 1-pager and include a bullet about guaranteed rollback windows and our minimal logging pledge for the POC.

lina (solutions): I'll finalize the capability matrix and append the benchmark appendix. Will ping once ready.

omar (AE): Owners: lina -> capability matrix + pricing bands, nidhi -> security questionnaire + DPA language, ashwin -> provisioning runbook + ops snippet, julia -> procurement 1-pager. I'll consolidate and send back to EdgeCare by EOD. Thanks team :rocket:

ashwin (eng-sre): Once I get non-overlapping CIDR & account ID I can book provisioning for next Tue.

omar (AE): Closing loop: NDA pending from buyer. If NDA signed, we'll share HSM diagrams and private runbook. Drop links back into this thread when ready.
